gameDescriptionHtml:
Contract Rush DX is a hand-animated run and gun, with multiple playable characters and a focus on exploration! Complete Contracts and collect power-ups that strengthen you immensely, all culminating in massive boss fights! With inspiration from flash cartoons/games of the 2000s, the visuals are hand-animated with a sharp and bold style.

Taking on Contracts will have you exploring large levels, all with their own set of enemies, NPCs, and secrets!

Power-ups will prepare you for the Contract’s boss battle at the end of the level. Power-ups can increase movement speed, spread-shot bullets, fire rate, and much more!

Sub-Contracts will have you taking on smaller challenge levels with a variety of objectives. Earn all 3 stars in each and get rewards!

Multiple playable characters, all with unique play styles. Some are focused on pure shoot’em up gameplay, others centered around melee attacks. If you’re having trouble on a level, sometimes trying out a new character is the key!
